name: Azalea no Mahoutsukai ~Shiawase no Recipe~
original_name: アゼリアの魔法使い ～幸せのレシピ～
source:
The protagonist is a princess of the Kingdom of Lumen.
However, due to a tragic accident, she falls into a deep sleep.
By the time she finally awakens, Lumen has already been destroyed by the Kingdom of Azelia.
Now living as a commoner, Lou becomes the apprentice of a sorcerer and spends her days in peace.
One day, just as she expects those peaceful days to continue, her master Dias suddenly tells her, “It’s time to live on your own.”
Will Lou be able to become independent?
translation:
主角是鲁门王国的公主。
然而，由于一场悲惨的事故，她陷入了沉睡。
当她最终醒来时，卢门已经被阿泽利亚王国毁灭了。
露如今过着平民生活，成为了魔法师的学徒，过着平静的日子。
有一天，正当她期待着平静的日子能够继续下去时，她的主人迪亚斯突然告诉她：“是时候独自生活了。”
卢先生能独立吗？
